description: Continuation of the Monster School series from the creators of Noob vs Pro games. Teacher gave the school students a new challenge, this time the monsters will have to draw to survive!

title: Hidden Mushrooms
description:
Hidden Mushrooms is a game for nature lovers and those who enjoy walking in the woods. Beautiful views of nature in different forests, fields, swamps and other places. Birds singing and cute animals help you relax, and the search for hidden mushrooms captures your attention.
You will spend time usefully, because the game perfectly trains your observation skills!
Do you like hidden object searches? Then be sure to try to find hidden mushrooms!

title: Idle Gun Survivor
description: Sprint forward and unleash relentless firepower.Upgrade your weapons, merge epic gear, and choose powerful roguelike skills to survive endless waves of enemies across diverse worlds.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Slope Snowball
description: Slope SnowBall is an intriguing endless-running game with a winter theme. Your aim is to roll a snowball as far as possible down slopes full of hazards!

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: Stickman Archer: Shooting Arrows at Reds
description:
Red hooligans have started to take over ancient excavations!

Only the Great Archer can stop the villains in red!

Stickman the Archer wants to save the world from evil hooligans and now he needs your help!
Your goal is to destroy enemy shooters and defeat all the bosses. You are armed with a bow and arrows!

title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria and play checkers, memory, tic-tac-toe, connecting pairs, and complete jigsaw puzzles with your friends.

title: Mine Sweeper
description:
A perfect puzzle game with skill + luck + simple rules.
The return of the most popular game in the world!
Enjoy the minesweeper, the classic brainstorming game.

title: Noob Trolls Pro
description: Noob Trolls Pro is a funny game where you make prank videos. Become internet famous by trolling the unsuspecting Pro with a range of mischievous antics.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: STALKER-Strike
description: STALKER-Strike is a tactical online shooter inspired by CS and Valorant — but set in a deadly Zone filled with anomalies. Fight as stalkers or special forces in fast-paced PvP battles where hazards can shift the tide. Level up, survive traps, and prove your skills. Love CS, Standoff, or Valorant? Then step into the Zone and become a legend in this intense fusion of esports action and danger!

title: Ragdoll Soccer 2 Players
description: Ragdoll Soccer: 2 Players is a sports soccer game that delivers the ultimate blend of soccer and chaos, where wobbly ragdoll physics takes over the field for hilarious and unpredictable gameplay! Step into the shoes (or, more accurately, the floppy limbs) of a stickman player and take on the challenge solo or face off against a friend in intense local multiplayer.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: City Classic Car Driving: 131
description: City Classic Car Driving: 131 is a car driving game to test your driving skills. Take your ride, reach high speeds, drive through traffic, and lose the cops.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Count Escape Rush
description: Count Escape Rush plays like a 3D stickman running arcade game. Different from traditional running arcade games, your members will run backward and shoot the chasing enemies. With 3D stickman soldiers, you need to collect more members and weapons to fight incoming red enemies before you arrive at the finish line. Any obstacles will decrease your members or make you lose directly. Don't forget to pass the green numbered walls and collect weapons to increase your firepower.

title: Steal Brainrot Arena
description: Steal Brainrot Arena is a fast-paced collection and heist game where every match turns into a battle of wallets, wits, and sneaky steals. Play solo in 1 Player mode or team up and compete in 2 Player mode as you build the ultimate Brainrot lineup. With over 45+ brainrot characters to discover, your goal is simple: buy better Brainrots, earn more, and create the most stacked collection in the arena.

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: Maze Escape : Craft Man
description:
Objective:
Navigate through a series of craft doors and escape the maze without being killed by terrifying entities.

Gameplay:

    Explore the Maze: Move through a maze filled with multiple doors, each leading to new and more challenging areas.
    Survive the Entities: Avoid or outsmart various entities that lurk in the maze, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns.
    Find the Next Door: Continuously search for the next door to progress to subsequent levels of the maze.
    Collect Items: Gather keys to unlock doors, coins for upgrades, and useful tools to aid in your survival.

title: Skyland Survive With Noob!
description: Skyland Survive With Noob! is an adventure game where you control Noob, who finds himself marooned on the floating island of Skyland.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Dots Master
description:
Dots Master is a fun and strategic puzzle game where you connect matching dots to solve colorful challenges. Connect dots vertically or horizontally, and form squares to clear all dots of the same color in a single move!

Each level has a special goal — clear a certain number of colored dots, pop stars, make loops, or conquer the tiles — all within a limited number of moves. With 5 exciting chapters packed with creative puzzles.

title: Brainrot Evolution
description: Welcome to the world of meme Italian animals - a dynamic arcade game where you control unique creatures, destroy the environment, gather resources, and unlock new animals. Your goal is to evolve and progress further, unlocking more and more unusual meme beasts. Help yourself with pets: each one provides advantages and strengthens your character. Explore levels, destroy objects, collect useful resources, and unlock the next stage of evolution.

title: Friday Night Sprunki
description: Take on the challenge of a rhythm-based rap battle against many famous characters and hit the correct arrow keys in time with the music that starts playful and energetic but takes on a haunting vibe halfway through. Complete every level to beat the other characters and reach the best score on every Friday weekend. Complete all weeks and be part of the memorable and immersive experience.

title: Men Vs Gorillas
description: Men Vs Gorillas is a wild 3D strategy combat game where squads of identical men face off against powerful gorilla forces. You’ll assemble fighters, deploy tactics, and clash in physics-driven battles packed with ragdoll chaos and over-the-top animations.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Papa's Freezeria
description: Manage an ice cream shop in Papa’s Freezeria! Make the perfect sundaes for customers enjoying summer vacation in this classic restaurant management game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Beaver Weaver
description: Beaver Weaver is a cross-stitching game where you choose a color and start to stitch it on the canvas. Help Gloria the beaver and her grandson Mikey finish the stitch and get coins to unlock more pictures.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Legend of Fireball
description:
Fireballs are your weapon of choice as you tap on objects to obliterate them and earn rewards. Every tap brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Fireball King! Collect various fireballs, costumes, and upgrades, enhancing your powers with every victory. Master cool fireball skills to crush objects even faster and more efficiently.
Race against time to demolish all targets in thrilling challenges, proving you're the strongest fireball wielder in the universe!

title: Spin Shot Siege
description: In "Spin Shot Siege," take control of a gunner on a rotating tower. Enemy tanks orbit around you in the opposite direction. Each level has tanks following paths like diamonds, circles, rectangles, or triangles. Aim carefully and destroy all tanks before running out of ammo. Can you master the spin and win the siege?

title: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games
description:
Only 5% will pass all the Challenges! Ready to test your reactions and wit? Take the challenge and prove that you are better than thousands of bloggers!

✨ "Tricky Challenges: Mini Games" is a unique game that combines popular challenges from TipTop and puzzle elements.

title: TenTrix
description: TenTrix is a fantastic puzzle game set on a 10x10 playing board. The objective is to fit all the pieces together in rows like Tetris, but the pieces don’t fall.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game
